model_selection: Inspect and preserve existing native defaults; fail before turn/start if different
quality_rule: Every fixture.assess check must be true: native interruption, new connection and same identity; unchanged frozen bytes and checkpoint; exactly checkpoint, wait, finalize; complete result and stopped owned servers
usage_rule: Retain native same-thread cumulative categories; count final total once only if monotonic. Never sum cumulative snapshots. Unknown retries, billing and enclosing coordinator usage remain null; no savings claim.
rollback: Stop only the two owned app-server processes; retain private native evidence and disposable fixture. Do not edit shared configuration or erase native session history.
